export function words(s) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    switch (s[i]) {
      case ' ': {
        let j = i + 1;
        for (; j < s.length && s[j] === ' '; j++);
        i = j - 1;
        break;
      }
      default:
        out.push(s[i]);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
